name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russia strikes Ukraine's grid and a Kharkiv postal hub; Ukraine hits Ryazan refinery with 200+ drones
state: Russia said it hit a Nova Poshta terminal near Kharkiv, a 330kV substation in Dnipropetrovsk region and a cargo ship off Odesa on 5 Nov; Ukraine said four civilians were killed in Donetsk region that day (Al Jazeera). Russia's Ryazan governor said more than 200 Ukrainian drones attacked overnight, setting the refinery ablaze. Russia launched 128 drones and two missiles into 5 Nov after mass strikes on the grid (Kyiv Post).
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against all travel to Ukraine. Strikes on energy can affect European gas and power prices.
rubric_hit: Alert: sustained mass strikes on energy infrastructure and civilian targets
